title: EnergySystems LoadForecastCSV

stats.done_summary: Successfully completed the Energy Systems Load Forecast CSV research task. Produced a comprehensive annual load forecast and reliability analysis report based on 7 days of 15-minute interval load data. Generated 13 figures, implemented multiple forecasting models (Mean, Naive, Seasonal Naive, SARIMA, LightGBM), created annual forecast for 2026 with monthly breakdown, and performed reliability assessment including capacity margin, LOLP, and EENS calculations. All deliverables are saved in the workspace with the final report at report/report.md.
